locations.rationale: $mailer->record("logged") where $mailer is an App\Service\EmailNotifier instance (imported as Mailer, constructed via Mailer::create(): self). EmailNotifier uses the LogsEvents trait, declares no own record method and no __call, so this instance method call resolves to LogsEvents::record.
$this->record($message) inside EmailNotifier::notify. EmailNotifier uses LogsEvents and defines no overriding record method, so $this->record resolves to the trait method LogsEvents::record.

records.rationale: The fixture is a minimal four-file PHP project: trait App\Support\LogsEvents declaring record (the selected declaration), interface App\Contracts\Notifier, class App\Service\EmailNotifier (implements Notifier, uses LogsEvents, calls $this->record), and script src/Consumer.php (aliases EmailNotifier as Mailer, calls $mailer->record). Directory listing tools were unavailable, so the tree was enumerated by exhaustive path probing using the Read tool's exact-stem suggestions; the discovered files form a closed, self-consistent fixture in which Consumer.php exercises every declared member of EmailNotifier (create, notify, record, $sent, __get via dynamicName), and no further entries were found under source/, src/, src/Support/, src/Service/, or src/Contracts/. Exactly two exact 'record' identifier tokens exist outside the declaration range and both semantically resolve to the trait method: EmailNotifier.php line 17 ($this->record) and Consumer.php line 9 ($mailer->record). Neither call is intercepted by magic methods (__get handles only property reads; no __call exists) and no class overrides record. Under bindings_optional there are no optional binding tokens: no import or export names the method record itself (the 'use App\Support\LogsEvents' import and the in-class 'use LogsEvents' trait-use reference the trait name, and 'use ... as Mailer' references the class). No other exact-name candidates required exclusion. definitionUsage is the URI-sorted first required location (src/Consumer.php precedes src/Service/EmailNotifier.php).
